title.zh: 为菲律宾武装部队自 1950 年 9 月 1 日至 1951 年 6 月 30 日期间拨付追加经费的法案
title.en: Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Armed Forces of the Philippines During the Period From September First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-One.
title.orig: Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Armed Forces of the Philippines During the Period From September First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-One.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1950/ra_576_1950.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, arc appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated as additional funds for the Armed Forces of the Philippines during the period from September first, nineteen hundred and fifty to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and fifty-one:
L. - DEPARTMENT OF NATIONAL DEFENSE IV. - SPECIAL PURPOSE 6a. For additional subsistence of troops assigned in active field operations at P1 per day: Provided, That no portion of this appropriation shall be transferred to any other item P6,500,000.00 6b. For expenses for hospitalization of veterans 210,000.00 6c. For the employment of temporary employees for the manufacture of an encoding and decoding device 30,000.00 Total for special purposes P6,740,000.00
(b) PHILIPPINE A1R FORCE
1. Base pay and longevity pay of officers P431.400.00
2. Flying pay of officers on flying status and per diems of special air corps instructor 252,500.00
3. Rentals and commutation of quarters for officers 73,600.00
4. Base pay of enlisted men 451,600.00
5. Hazardous duty pay in accordance with section l(a), Republic Act No. 315 16,600.00
6. Flying pay of enlisted men 174,170.00
7. Additional pay for air mechanics 45,800.00
8. Additional pay for air specialists.
78,300.00

(e) PHILIPPINE NAVAL PATROL
1. Base pay and longevity pay of officers P537,560.00

(e) INTELLIGENCE SERVICE
1. For intelligence, counter-intelligence and propaganda including salaries, travel­ ing expenses, miscellaneous and incidental expenses in connection with intelligence work :
a. Salaries and allowances of secret agents P400,000.00
b. Traveling expenses of agents 350,000.00
c. Telegrams, postage and communication expenses 12,500.00
d. Supplies 17,000.00
e. Equipment 8,300.00
f. Rewards and purchase of information 38,300.00
g. Propaganda 41,600.00
h. Miscellaneous 32,200 00 Total for the Intelligence Service P899,900 00 Totals P17,184,444.00 VI. - SPECIAL PROVISION
1. No appropriation in this Act shall be transferred from one command to another.

This Act shall take effect on September 1, 1950.
Approved, September 8, 1950.
